The Pokémon Comprehensive Laboratory (Japanese: ポケモン Pokémon Comprehensive Laboratory), or PCL (Japanese: PCL) for short, is a research facility in the game . The laboratory is located on a mountain pass in east Ryme City in the district of East Highland . Scientists here research the abilities of Pokémon and have developed various inventions. 

PC was founded by John Waals over 20 years ago in an effort to improve the relationship between people and Pokémon. The lab was temporarily shut down ten years ago for two years due to damage caused by a berserk Pokémon. Contemporary researchers include Wallace Carroll, Carlos Hernando, Frederick Hartfield, and Nina O'Hara, with current director Dorothy Fisher. The compound is divided between Building A on the left and Building B on the right, with a courtyard between them.

Tim and Pikachu investigate PCL under the cover of working there as a part-time job. Most of Chapter 3 takes place here.

The Pokémon Comprehensive Laboratory (Japanese: ポケモン Pokémon Comprehensive Laboratory), or PCL (Japanese: PCL) for short, is a research facility in the game . The laboratory is located on a mountain pass in east Ryme City in the district of East Highland . Scientists here research the abilities of Pokémon and have developed various inventions. 

PC was founded by John Waals over 20 years ago in an effort to improve the relationship between people and Pokémon. The lab was temporarily shut down ten years ago for two years due to damage caused by a berserk Pokémon. Contemporary researchers include Wallace Carroll, Carlos Hernando, Frederick Hartfield, and Nina O'Hara, with current director Dorothy Fisher. The compound is divided between Building A on the left and Building B on the right, with a courtyard between them.

Tim and Pikachu investigate PCL under the cover of working there as a part-time job. Most of Chapter 3 takes place here.

==Pokémon==
 

==In the movie==
 
 
The PCL appeared in . It was where a team of scientists led by Dr. Ann Laurent conducted experiments on Pokémon Evolution. Among the projects seen at the lab were experiments meant to enhance the strength of and create . Most notably, was imprisoned at the laboratory after Harry Goodman helped track it down at the behest of Howard Clifford. However, Harry learned the truth about Howard's plans for Mewtwo and the chemical R created from its DNA, and assisted it in escaping. Mewtwo destroyed the laboratory during its escape, leading to it being sealed off as a hazardous site.

Later, while investigating Harry's disappearance, Tim Goodman and Lucy Stevens broke into the abandoned laboratory. They found the Greninja and Torterra still present in the facility, as well as records of Laurent's work on R and a neural link device. Unbeknownst to them, they were being monitored by Ms. Norman, who was in the guise of Howard's son Roger. She released the Greninja to drive them away.
